epics.title: Runtime Environment Initialization Repair
epics.jtbd: When the end customer attempts to launch the application, I want the system to start successfully without network conflicts, so that the product is actually available for use.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: from 100% startup failure to 0% startup failure
requirements: R1: Repair the backend container network configuration so it can resolve host.docker.internal and fix the backup container initialization script permissions.

slices.title: Repair backend network configuration and backup container permissions
slices.jtbd: When implementing R1 for this feature, I want the backend to correctly resolve internal hosts and the backup script to run, so that the system health check passes and the product becomes available.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application containers are starting
When the health check is executed
Then it resolves host.docker.internal correctly without a NameResolutionError
And the backup script runs without a Permission denied error
And the containers remain running
slices.sixSigmaMetric: from 100% startup errors to 0% startup errors
